## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, types, tests, docs)
- [ ] Tested manually with `npm run dev` (light and dark theme, phone width for UI)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, including **deny** cases for permissions and validation
- [ ] Docs updated (guide / README / `database-schema.md` / CHANGELOG "Unreleased")
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, logs, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] Schema changes: migration generated, SQL reviewed, backwards compatible
- [ ] New third-party script, image host or frame is allowlisted in `security.server.ts`, with a reason
